svg.title: The heater driven by a sine at three speeds
svg.desc: A 5 percentage point sine moves the water by 0.91 degrees Celsius at 0.1 radians per second but only 0.46 degrees at 0.4 radians per second. At 0.2 radians per second the temperature peaks 4.8 seconds after the command. The first cycle of each sine carries the start, with a mean up to 0.15 degrees high.
